maria: Heads up — after enabling quantized KV-prefetch on qwen-14b for dedicated pools, rolling p95 latency up ~18% on short-context requests (<=64). Memory usage dropped ~22% though. Repro: `REPRO_SHARDS=8 ./bench/latency --model qwen-14b --seq 32 --batch 1 --kv-quant=fp8-prefetch`
Log snippet: ```[2026-03-17T15:03:21Z] p95=62ms -> 73ms, mem=11.2GB -> 8.7GB``` Anyone else see this? :eyes:

aj: Noticed similar on a small prod slice. Can you paste the kernel-routing config used? Also pls run `perf record -g` on the prefetch thread. Might be falling back to slow kernels.

ravi: Two quick notes: 1) RoPE scaling for qwen interacts badly when we pack KV into compact fp8 blobs — alignment/stride mismatch causes the fused attention kernel to choose a fallback path. 2) For models with nonstandard heads/kv dims (qwen mixes 64/128 dims in some variants) our kernel selector misestimates workspace and picks the generic matmul.

lauren: Repro command I used locally: `./tools/run_inference --model qwen-14b --batch 1 --context 48 --kv-mode=quant-prefetch --profile=cpu`. If you add `--kv-prefetch-window=16` latency gets worse; `--kv-prefetch-window=96` reduces p95 but increases mem.

perf-bot: CI perf run: https://ci.internal.redwood/perf/9872 shows a regression in the prefetch path for qwen-14b/quant. Flamegraph attached in CI (see flamegraph.svg). Key hotspot: `select_kernel_for_attention()` and `kv_prefetch_worker()` stalls on memcpy.

kai: Short-term mitigation: pin prefix-cache to fp16 for small seqs (<=64) and single-stream batches, keep fp8 for long-context. Also add heuristic to kernel router: if kv-layout==quant and head_dim%128!=0 -> prefer small-matmul kernel instead of fused attention. That should avoid fallback cost.

maria: Sounds good. I'll run an A/B: fp16-prefix vs fp8-prefetch with kernel-router tweak. Assigning: aj -> perf traces + perf record; ravi -> kernel-router heuristic patch; lauren -> run sweep for prefetch-window {16,32,64,96} and capture p50/p95 and mem. Kai please prepare a Canary config to lock fp16 for prefix.

kai: Will do, pushing canary config to dedicated pools and adding a short-circuit rule in router.

aj: Uploaded perf traces to /artifacts/qwen-prefetch/1785678901/ — main diff shows extra memcpy and a missed vectorized path in `qgemm_vnni` for certain head dims.

ravi: If the kernel-selector change is cheap I'll test it on mixtral and llama variants too — we've seen similar oddities there. Might be worth a small regression test in CI that validates kernel choice for common head_dim values.

maria: Good call. Action items: 1) run A/B and post numbers here, 2) kernel-router patch PR, 3) add kernel-choice regression test. Back in ~3 hours with initial numbers. :thumbsup:
